_about: Curated CORDIS DET queries for Connecting Europe Facility (CEF) call subjects, keyed by the subject the tagger looks up (Call.topic_title where present, else the call title / Call.name). Subjects auto-extracted verbatim from the work-programme JSON, queries AI-authored + adversarially verified in the contenttype=project phrase-quoted style of cluster_1.json/cluster_3.json. CORDIS indexes EU RESEARCH projects (FP1-Horizon Europe); for non-research calls (and broad funding instruments such as ERC/MSCA) these find thematically related research, so a call's tags are the research fields of related funded projects, NOT its official scope. Re-run POST /cordis/tag-calls {"source":"cef"} to apply.

queries.Cross-border renewables: contenttype=project AND ("cross-border renewable energy" OR "offshore wind" OR "offshore renewable energy" OR "renewable energy") AND ("grid integration" OR "transmission grid" OR "electricity interconnector" OR "cross-border interconnection")
queries.Cross-border renewables - Studies: contenttype=project AND ("cross-border renewable energy" OR "renewable energy" OR "offshore wind" OR "offshore renewable energy") AND ("grid integration" OR "feasibility study" OR "cross-border interconnection" OR "energy system planning")
queries.Cross-border renewables - Works: contenttype=project AND ("cross-border renewable energy" OR "offshore wind" OR "offshore renewable energy" OR "renewable energy") AND ("power grid" OR "transmission grid" OR "electricity interconnector" OR "grid infrastructure")
queries.Submarine Cable Repair Capacities-Pilot: contenttype=project AND ("submarine cable" OR "subsea cable" OR "undersea cable" OR "submarine telecommunications cable") AND ("cable repair" OR "subsea infrastructure" OR "cable resilience" OR "critical infrastructure protection")
